REVIEW HANDOFF and CLAIM RELEASED — session `ADB991-claude-20261113-bfb3`

Claim: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/160#issuecomment-6862024252
Report-only draft PR: #228 (branch `claude/issue-160-bfb3` @ `55bb3f4`, base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `69b2631`). It adds `blueprint/interfaces/reviews/continuum-reconstruction-lean-ADB991-claude-20261113-bfb3.md`.
Reviewed: `blueprint/interfaces/continuum-reconstruction.md` at `fdfd086` (PR #170), SHA-256 `c6748f0844a71a0d35f859b2ca62ed69be8b6fb4835e3116f36d343b7aa3c558`, against pin `3456e5e7`. The evidence is source-text only, with no elaboration.

**Established.** No false description of a source declaration was found. All 14 response-table rows are answered as stated. The field lists of `Seed`, `Locals`, `Relativistic`, `Selection.Certificate`, `Wightman.Realizes`, `Completed` and `Headline.Reconstruction` are complete. The `Realizes` reading marked "unverified" in the PU-18 row is now checked field by field:
- normalized cyclic vacuum and dense domain;
- Schwartz-continuous fields;
- formal adjoints via `J`;
- spacelike commutation;
- unitary proper orthochronous Poincaré covariance;
- closed forward-cone spectrum;
- unique vacuum.

The reading omits `meets`, under which the Wightman functions equal `A.world`, the boundary values of the selected contour.

**Changes requested (minor, ownership and wording only):**
- **R1.** The pointwise mixture identity is PU-17's barycenter. `Completed.at_words` is proved as `F.α.space.barycenter _ F.phase.phase.decomposition F.phase.phase.chosen F.room.kernel.translations` (`YM/EveryPhase/Extension.lean` 79–80) and uses no field of `L`. So P9.2's two mixtures belong to PU-17 and PU-19 respectively, not both to PU-19.
- **R2.** Producers of the public `Reconstructed` clauses. `covers` uses `F.phase.transport.injection` (`Spec.Locals`, the derivative unit), and `characterContinuity` uses the PU-17 certificate. `YangMills.publicReconstruction` uses no PU-19 output and no `Relativistic.allWorld`. PU-19 is therefore needed only for the internal conjuncts of `YangMills.constructed`, not for `JointExistence`. This partly answers open question 4.
- **R3.** The full-mesh `Ordered` is derived. `YM.FullVolume.Final.from_spec` (`Program.lean` 117–126, used at `Accepted.lean` 165) obtains it from `F.room.ordered` plus PU-15's `PositionsUV R.family .full`, by uniqueness of limits along a subsequence.
- **R4.** `YM.MergeProof.Acme.emanate` consumes `s.copies` as well as `s.corrected`. `YM.MergeProof.Accent.rated` returns the whole `Seed`, and its proof starts with the extraction `Extraction.crops`.
- **R5.** `Final.calibration : Spec.Calibrated C`, which is the source of `constructed`'s `Spec.Calibrated C` conjunct, and `Final.sector` are not assigned.

**Uncertain or not checked.** No `#print axioms` or kernel replay was run. The proofs of `Headline.SeparatedOPE`, `Headline.TraceExclusions` and `rated` past line 54 were not read, so the PU-19 conclusion is stated from the types and from the bridge proof. The literature side (#6) was not addressed.

**Next.** The note's owner answers R1–R5 by a small edit to `continuum-reconstruction.md`. Then human acceptance follows. A further correspondence review is needed only if the edit goes beyond R1–R5. This is an agent-assisted review, not an acceptance.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
